          - Official [Python 3.13 support](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-python/pull/2863), thanks Kevin!
          - Support for getting the [supported endpoints from the REST catalog](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-python/pull/2848), thanks Drew!
          - [Foundational](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-python/pull/2861) [work](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-python/pull/2842) for scan planning client support, thanks again Drew!
      - Iceberg-Rust

          - Thanks Alan for fixing [IEEE 754 ordering](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-rust/pull/1959) for float and double
          - Thanks Shawn for adding [logic to convert an Arrow schema](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-rust/pull/1928) to an Iceberg schema (with IDs ð)
          - Thanks Kevin for [fixing the release script](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-rust/pull/1956)
          - Thanks Lo for [preventing a potential deadlock](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-rust/pull/1937) during scan-planning
          - Thanks Matt for fixing the [Decimal](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-rust/pull/1921).
      - Iceberg-cpp

          - Thanks Gang for implementing the [transaction api](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/418) and [delete file index](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/435)
          - Thanks Heartlinked for adding REST catalog functionalities ([create](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/417), [stage-create](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/485), [list and update](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/484), [load and drop](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/438))
          - Thanks Junwang for adding [rolling manifest writer](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/443) and [snapshot cached manifests](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/444)
          - Thanks Xinli for adding [FileWriter interface for data file writers](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-cpp/pull/446)
      - Iceberg-go

          - Thanks Dao for adding support for [V3 Unknown Type](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-go/pull/605)
          - Thanks Tobias for adding support for [row lineage tracking in metadata update ](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-go/pull/659)
          - Thanks ferhat for fixing potential [leaks in rest response bodies](https://github.com/apache/iceberg-go/pull/655)
  - Releases

      - Iceberg-Rust 0.8.0 is ready for a second round of voting
      - Iceberg 1.11.0 [[DISCUSS] thread is out](https://lists.apache.org/thread/j99tc4xp246xzz7ymtbk9lmh7k2oyw3s)
      - PyIceberg 0.11.0 is being wrapped up
  - Agenda items

      - [Steven] should the spec calls out certain invalid writer behaviors in the implementation notes section.

          - Disallow row undeletion by unsetting the bit in updated DV or position delete ([dev thread](https://lists.apache.org/thread/97hpwtkm6m8026z76m3240gwvqd8prd9), [spec PR](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/14731))
          - Add implementation notes for writer behavior to avoid duplicate files ([dev thread](https://lists.apache.org/thread/tlwrd245wsrsrn4mytqjg6dopj98g2hc))
          - Writers shouldn’t add back files that are already deleted, which can lead to race conditions like following

              - T1: add F1 in S1
              - T2: delete F1 and add F2 in S2
              - T3: add F3 in S3
              - T4: expire snapshot S1 and S2 and schedule F1 for deletion. Concurrently, another DML adds back F1. This could cause the table in broken state with missing data file F1.
      - [Vishal] Could fixing the non-RFC compliant UUID comparison bug be targeted for Iceberg 2.0.0 as it introduces breaking changes? ([devlist thread](https://lists.apache.org/thread/6r4fkho84z4240fpk4kl5bnlf542n0pm), [issue](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/issues/14216), [PR](https://github.com/apache/iceberg/pull/14500))
      - [Ajantha] Should the “register view” update the catalog name? (spark compatibility issue) <https://lists.apache.org/thread/yt430r50xp9v5jmhf79m3o56q05x9k3v>
      - [Kevin] Deprecate Spark 3.4
      - [Kevin] project blog, [iceberg.apache.org/blogs/](http://iceberg.apache.org/blogs/)
